org.name: SageBio
org.details: Open Science and Open Source. Creator of Synapse.org, NIH-listed generalist repository for biomedical data managing 2+PB data. Enabler of DREAM biomedical challenges

title: Anyone who wants to team up?

latest.raw: I struggled with a >ton< of health issues myself and I can only imagine what this family is going through. This challenge resonated on a deep (emotional) level. Hope we can help push the field forward. Would love to contribute. Looking for teammates. Don't have a medical degree. CS/engineering degree & founder. Went pretty deep into genetic data/biochemistry to understand my own condition. Would love to apply what I've learned and hopefully help out.

latest.raw: Hi there. I'm about to graduate with a degree in biochemistry and this project caught my eye as well. I don't have much experience reading genomes, but I do have a strong general scientific foundation. Right now, the dataset is getting too large for my computer to handle. Let me know if you're interested!
